notes.title: v1.0.6 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Updates based on recent feedback.

If you have feedback or issues please feel free to let me know so I can deal with things as fast as possible. If you just have fun I would love to hear from you as well!! I monitor both the steam discussions for the game, and the SPOG discord.

[b]Following changelog may contain spoilers!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44164828/ee1e8c9d0b314a14ba0e2a335370ab3b9703b93a.jpg[/img]

[b]v1.0.6[/b]
	+ Fixed - Smacking the GreenKey UP could knock it out of players reach.
	+ Fixed - GreenLockDoor's rusty hinges.
	+ Fixed - Otto's footlocker's sticky lid.
	+ Fixed - Couldn't step up on a stool before the stool was grabbed.
	+ Fixed - Drowning from "no reason" in a few niche situations.
	+ Fixed - Exploit for cheat exit out of the pit.
	+ Fixed - Ambient SFX issues when manipulating some items in Pirate Den.
	+ Changed - GreenLockDoor can now open outward too.
	+ Changed - Lowered the Draw Bridge weight for less bounce on its draw rope.
	+ Changed - Lowered barrel weight to reduce hands freaking out in certain situations.
	+ Changed - Player Lean over a static object from .4 meter to .5 meter.
	+ Added - More forgiving wall & floor colliders to the Pit.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Huge update to physics backend stuff. I believe I have got everything reported to me fixed up now.

If you have feedback or issues please feel free to let me know so I can deal with things as fast as possible. If you just have fun I would love to hear from you as well!! I monitor both the steam discussions for the game, and the SPOG discord.

[b]Following changelog may contain spoilers!![/b]

v1.0.4_Full
	+ Added impact sounds to Flashlights, Small Fuses, Large Fuses and Bananas
	+ Added collider to Church window.
	+ Added Physics Velocity calculation boost to Fuse objects (damn you PhysX)
	+ Changed Large Backpack slots so items are now pulled out by grabbing the object like pockets.
	+ Changed mesh and colliders on All Fuses.
	+ Changed mesh of CreepyDoll.
	+ Changed colliders on Master bedroom Dresser.
	+ Changed many things behind the scenes for better physics calculations.
	+ Fixed sticky hinge on Master Bedroom door.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
If you have feedback or issues please feel free to let me know so I can deal with things as fast as possible. If you just have fun I would love to hear from you as well!! I monitor both the steam discussions for the game, and the SPOG discord.

Following changelog may contain spoilers!!

	+ Changed Korvin's handwriting to be more bold for easier reading.
	+ Changed Steam Gauge Needles to Red with a slight glow to make them more noticeable.
	+ Changed light switch collider, it was extended for hopefully easier use.
	+ Changed Eating trigger area to be slightly larger.
	+ Changed clue on Otto's bedroom door to be much easier to notice.
	+ Added initial fuel to small fuel can, so player doesn't have to fill it the first time.
	+ Added lettering to large Fuel Tank to be more noticeable.
	+ Added some extra marks to Church book to make A & B letters more noticeable.
	+ Added more stools in Pit to make it easier for people that did not toss some in.
	+ Moved a spare lighter from Otto's bedroom to the Church.
	+ Moved pockets/holsters forward on the player very slightly.
